title.target: méi néng yíbìng dàihuí de běnshì
title.english: What He Could Not Simply Bring Back

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī xiān jiào tǎ wéi kàn shuǐ , bùxǔ xiān mō tóng jiàn .
pairs.english: Instructor Bai first told Tavi to watch the water, not touch the copper yet.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师先叫塔维看水，不许先摸铜件。

pairs.target: tā gé zhe zhuō zhàn le yíhuìer , cái xiǎngqǐ nà zhī xiǎo wēnbiāo gāi bǎizài nǎbiān .
pairs.english: He stood across the table a while before remembering where the small thermometer belonged.
pairs.hanzi: 他隔着桌站了一会儿，才想起那只小温标该摆在哪边。

pairs.target: shàng huí zài zhèlǐ , zìjǐ hái zhīdào měi yìzhāng zhǐ fàng nǎér , chūmén zhèxiē rìzi , tiějiá , shízuò hé lùpái sāi le mǎnnǎozǐ , yǎnqián zhè duì duǎn tóng jiàn fǎndǎo xiàng gùyì bú rèn tā .
pairs.english: Last time he knew every paper's place. Days away had filled his head with iron clamps, stone bases and road signs; the short copper pair now seemed deliberately unfamiliar.
pairs.hanzi: 上回在这里，自己还知道每一张纸放哪儿，出门这些日子，铁夹、石座和路牌塞了满脑子，眼前这对短铜件反倒像故意不认他。

pairs.target: tèlún zài lìng yìzhuō huànshuǐ , jiàn tā shēnshǒu qù ná wēnbiāo , xiān jiāng pángbiān gānbù dì lái , shuō bié bǎ xiùkǒu yě suàn jìnshuǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: Teren was changing water at another table. Seeing him reach for the thermometer, he offered a dry cloth: don't count your cuff in the water too.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦在另一桌换水，见他伸手去拿温标，先将旁边干布递来，说别把袖口也算进水里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le kàn zìjǐ shī zhe de yìjiǎo , dītóu cā le , méi hǎoyìsi shuō nà zhèngshì jìnmén shí cèng de .
pairs.english: Tavi dried the wet corner, embarrassed to say he had brushed it wet on entering.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了看自己湿着的一角，低头擦了，没好意思说那正是进门时蹭的。

pairs.target: tóng jiàn réng shì lǎoshī yàn guò de nà yíduì , zhěngjiàn tǐjī xiāngděng , wēnshuǐ zài wàitou , liáng dài zài lìngyìduān , shǒu yào chù de dìfāng lìng yǒu dǎng hù , bú tàng .
pairs.english: The copper was the same teacher-checked pair, equal in whole volume, with external warm water and cool bags at opposite ends; guarded hand-contact patches were not hot.
pairs.hanzi: 铜件仍是老师验过的那一对，整件体积相等，温水在外头，凉袋在另一端，手要触的地方另有挡护，不烫。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī ràng tā xiān jì búyòng jiè xìng shí rè zǒu dé duō kuài , zài shuāngshǒu fàngshàngqù , bù qǐ biànhuà , yě jì yìhuí .
pairs.english: Bai first had him record heat-flow speed without borrowing, then with both hands resting on the pieces without casting, recording that too.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师让他先记不用借性时热走得多快，再双手放上去，不起变化，也记一回。

pairs.target: shǒu zìjǐ de nuǎnyì ruò bù xiān suànjìnqù , hòutou duō chūlái yìdiǎn , jiù dōu róngyì suàn gěi běnshì .
pairs.english: Without counting the hands' own warmth first, any later increase could easily be credited to ability.
pairs.hanzi: 手自己的暖意若不先算进去，后头多出来一点，就都容易算给本事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi míngbái zhèhuà , zhēn děng nà liǎngtiáo xìxìde jìlù wǎngqiánzǒu , xīnlǐ háishì yǒuxiē jí .
pairs.english: Tavi understood, but watching the two fine traces advance still made him impatient.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维明白这话，真等那两条细细的记录往前走，心里还是有些急。

pairs.target: tā zài zhé tóng zuò guò néng liúxiàlái de kòu , bān guò yìhuí jiù kàndéjiàn lìngyìhuí shǎo rào de dìfāng , yǎnxià què yào zhàn zhe , kàn shuǐ yìdiǎndiǎn biàn .
pairs.english: At Zhetong he had made a lasting clasp and seen effort saved on the next carrying trip; now he had to stand watching water change little by little.
pairs.hanzi: 他在折桐做过能留下来的扣，搬过一回就看得见另一回少绕的地方，眼下却要站着，看水一点点变。

pairs.target: tèlún yǐjīng xiě wán yíduàn , jiāng zìjǐ de zhǐ nuókāi liàng . tā nà yíduì de qǐtóu shíchén tóngtǎ wéi bùtóng , dúshù bùnéng zhíjiē bǐ .
pairs.english: Teren finished a section and set his paper to dry. His pair had started at a different time from Tavi's, so readings could not be compared directly.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦已经写完一段，将自己的纸挪开晾。他那一对的起头时辰同塔维不同，读数不能直接比。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái xiǎng piēyìyǎn kàn zìjǐ màn le duōshǎo , duìfāng táitóu wèn tā zhǎo shénme , tā zhǐhǎo xiào zhe chéngrèn , zìjǐ chàdiǎn bǎ liǎngzhāng zhǐ dàngchéng pǎobù .
pairs.english: Tavi had wanted to glance over to see how far behind he was. Asked what he sought, he laughed and admitted nearly treating the papers like a race.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来想瞥一眼看自己慢了多少，对方抬头问他找什么，他只好笑着承认，自己差点把两张纸当成跑步。

pairs.target: " nà wǒ zǎo pǎo le bànquān . " tèlún shuō .
pairs.english: “Then I started half a lap ahead,” Teren said.
pairs.hanzi: “那我早跑了半圈。”特伦说。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī guòlái , méi jiào tāmen bìzuǐ , zhī wèn tǎ wéi zhèhuí xiān kàn nǎ yìbiān .
pairs.english: Bai came over without silencing them, only asking which side Tavi would watch first.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师过来，没叫他们闭嘴，只问塔维这回先看哪一边。

pairs.target: tā dá le , yòu bǎ dáàn gǎichéng liǎngbiān gèzì yuánlái de sùdù , bùnéng guāng dīng zhe wēnbiāo gāodī .
pairs.english: He answered, then corrected himself: each side's baseline rate, not only thermometer height.
pairs.hanzi: 他答了，又把答案改成两边各自原来的速度，不能光盯着温标高低。

pairs.target: lǎoshī diǎntóu , ràng tā chóngxīn bǎi wěn shǒuzhǐ , jīnrì zhī zuò yícì , zuò bù chū yě bù bǔsài .
pairs.english: The teacher nodded, had him settle his fingers again: one attempt today, no makeup race if it failed.
pairs.hanzi: 老师点头，让他重新摆稳手指，今日只做一次，做不出也不补赛。

pairs.target: tā de shuāngshǒu fàngzài dǎng hù jiān liúchū de jiēchùmiàn shàng , qǐchū zhī juéde zìjǐ jìde dòngzuò , méi jìde gāi zěnyàng bǎ zhùyì fàngjìnqù .
pairs.english: Both hands rested on the guarded contact patches; at first he remembered the motions but not how to bring his attention into them.
pairs.hanzi: 他的双手放在挡护间留出的接触面上，起初只觉得自己记得动作，没记得该怎样把注意放进去。

pairs.target: tā méi zài xīnlǐ zhǎo yì lěng yí rè , zhuǎnér xiǎng nà liǎngjiàn wánzhěng de tóng , ér búshì duāntóu yìxiǎopiàn yǐjīng nuǎn le de dìfāng .
pairs.english: He did not seek cold and heat in his mind, but attended to both whole copper pieces, not just the small warmed patch at an end.
pairs.hanzi: 他没在心里找一冷一热，转而想那两件完整的铜，而不是端头一小片已经暖了的地方。

pairs.target: xìxiàn zhōngyú tóng yuánlái lākāi yìdiǎn . yìbiān zǒu kuài xiē , lìngyìbiān mànxiē , shuǐ bìng méi hūrán biànchéng liǎngzhǒng yánsè , yě méiyǒu nǎ zhī liáng dài píngkōng jiéshuāng .
pairs.english: The traces finally diverged slightly from baseline, one faster, one slower. The water did not change color or a cool bag magically frost over.
pairs.hanzi: 细线终于同原来拉开一点。一边走快些，另一边慢些，水并没忽然变成两种颜色，也没有哪只凉袋凭空结霜。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe kàn , tīngjiàn bǎi lǎoshī shuō gòu le , cái zhīdào zìjǐ yǐjīng bǎ jiān tí dé tài gāo .
pairs.english: Watching, Tavi heard Bai say enough and realized he had lifted his shoulders too high.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着看，听见柏老师说够了，才知道自己已经把肩提得太高。

pairs.target: shuāngshǒu réng zài , tā xiān jiěkāi , zài sōngkāi shǒu , wǎng hòutuì bànbù .
pairs.english: With both hands still touching, he canceled first, then released and stepped half a pace back.
pairs.hanzi: 双手仍在，他先解开，再松开手，往后退半步。

pairs.target: lǎoshī ràng tā zuò , tèlún huànhuí zhǔnbèi hǎo de shuǐ , tā bāng zhe jì zhòngzhì hòu de shíchén .
pairs.english: The teacher seated him. Teren replaced the prepared water, and Tavi helped record the reset time.
pairs.hanzi: 老师让他坐，特伦换回准备好的水，他帮着记重置后的时辰。

pairs.target: yòu děng le yíduàn , yuánlái de sùdù chóngxīn duì shàng , tā zài zhǐbiān xiěxià tíng de dìfāng , yǎndǐ nà diǎn bēngzhe de gǎnjué yě mànmàn tuì le .
pairs.english: After another wait the baseline rates matched again. He marked where he had stopped, the tension behind his eyes slowly easing.
pairs.hanzi: 又等了一段，原来的速度重新对上，他在纸边写下停的地方，眼底那点绷着的感觉也慢慢退了。

pairs.target: búshì yíxià bǐ cóngqián qiáng le xǔduō , yě búshì chūmén biàn bǎ kè dōu wàng le .
pairs.english: He had neither suddenly grown much stronger nor forgotten every lesson while away.
pairs.hanzi: 不是一下比从前强了许多，也不是出门便把课都忘了。

pairs.target: tā yǒuxiē shuōbùqīng zìjǐ dàodǐ mǎnyì bù mǎnyì , bǎi lǎoshī kàn tā zuò zhe róu yǎnjiǎo , shuō zhè zhāng zhǐ kěyǐ dàizǒu , tóng jiàn bùnéng , bié huíqù ná zào shàng de guō liàn .
pairs.english: Unsure whether he felt satisfied, he rubbed his eyes. Bai said he could take the paper, not the copper; no practicing on a cooking pot at home.
pairs.hanzi: 他有些说不清自己到底满意不满意，柏老师看他坐着揉眼角，说这张纸可以带走，铜件不能，别回去拿灶上的锅练。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , shuō zìjǐ hái méi nàme è . tèlún táitóu dào , zhème děng xiàqù , cài dǎo néng xiān ràng yǎnjīng dīng shú .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed: he was not that hungry yet. Teren said waiting so long might cook food by staring first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，说自己还没那么饿。特伦抬头道，这么等下去，菜倒能先让眼睛盯熟。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī jiāng liǎng rén de zhǐ fēnkāi , jiào tā shuō xiào guī shuō xiào , qǐtóu nà gé shíchén bié yòu chāo cuò .
pairs.english: Bai separated their papers: joke all you like, but don't copy the starting time wrongly again.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师将两人的纸分开，叫他说笑归说笑，起头那格时辰别又抄错。

pairs.target: wǔhòu mǐlā hé kàn wán chūlái , shǒulǐ jiá zhe xīntiān de pīzhù , méi shuō quán shì hǎohuà .
pairs.english: Mira emerged from review that afternoon with new comments, not all praise.
pairs.hanzi: 午后米拉核看完出来，手里夹着新添的批注，没说全是好话。

pairs.target: tā shuō huíqù dé tóng sū yǐ xiān bǎ dǎng shuǐ piàn chóngshì , kěn shì yè shāi de nà jiā yě yào chóngxīn yuē , lǎoshī méi tì tā bǎ rénjiā yuànmén dǎkāi .
pairs.english: She and Suyi must retest the splash guard and reschedule the willing household; the teacher had not opened anyone's courtyard for her.
pairs.hanzi: 她说回去得同苏苡先把挡水片重试，肯试叶筛的那家也要重新约，老师没替她把人家院门打开。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng wèn ní hé , jiàn tā hái zài fān nà zhāng pīzhù , xiān jiāng zìjǐ liú de liángchá tuīguòqù .
pairs.english: Tavi meant to ask about the silt box, but seeing her still reading the comments, offered the cool tea he had saved.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想问泥盒，见她还在翻那张批注，先将自己留的凉茶推过去。

pairs.target: yīwén láide shāowǎn , liǎnshàng yě méi zuóyè nàyàng qīngkuài .
pairs.english: Iven came a little later, less cheerful than last night too.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文来得稍晚，脸上也没昨夜那样轻快。

pairs.target: tā shuō zuórì wǔfàn , duìfāng xiǎng jiào zìjǐ xiān zài yíyè jiāojiē zìjù páng liúmíng , shuō búguò shì zhèngmíng tīng guò .
pairs.english: At yesterday's lunch, he said, they wanted his name beside a page of handover wording, supposedly just proof he had heard it.
pairs.hanzi: 他说昨日午饭，对方想叫自己先在一页交接字句旁留名，说不过是证明听过。

pairs.target: zìjǐ wèn zhèngmíng tīng guò nǎ yì bǎn , zhuōbiān jiù ānjìng le , fùqīn huíqù lùshang jīhū méi shuōhuà .
pairs.english: He asked which version he was proving he had heard. The table fell quiet, and his father barely spoke on the way back.
pairs.hanzi: 自己问证明听过哪一版，桌边就安静了，父亲回去路上几乎没说话。

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn tā liú le méiyǒu . tā yáotóu , shuō méi ná shī nán de míngzì dǎng , zhī shuō zìjǐ hái fēnbùqīng nà jǐjù yìng suàn shuí dehuà .
pairs.english: Mira asked if he had signed. He shook his head: he had not hidden behind Shinan, only said he could not yet tell whose words those were.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问他留了没有。他摇头，说没拿施南的名字挡，只说自己还分不清那几句应算谁的话。

pairs.target: bìng méi rén dāngchǎng mà tā , fàn yě zhàoyàng chī wán , kě zìjǐ rújīn fǎndǎo bù zhīdào fùqīn shì xián tā bùdǒngshì , háishì lìng yǒu huà yào jiǎng .
pairs.english: Nobody scolded him and the meal finished normally, yet now he could not tell whether his father thought him immature or had something else to say.
pairs.hanzi: 并没人当场骂他，饭也照样吃完，可自己如今反倒不知道父亲是嫌他不懂事，还是另有话要讲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe liǎng rén de zhǐ , hūrán jiāng zìjǐ de nà zhāng yě tānkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at their papers, then suddenly spread out his own.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着两人的纸，忽然将自己的那张也摊开。

pairs.target: sānzhāng zhǐ shuí dōu kàn bù quán , mǐlā zhǐzhe tā biāo dé xiàng dòuyá de xiàn xiào , yīwén yě còujìn , wèn néng bunéng xiān cóng zhè liǎngtiáo jiūjìng nǎtiáo zǒu kuài shuōqǐ , bié yíxià bǎ tāmen dōu zhǔ jìn nà pén wēnshuǐ .
pairs.english: None could read all three pages. Mira laughed at his bean-sprout lines, and Iven leaned closer: start with which line went faster, don't boil them all in that warm water at once.
pairs.hanzi: 三张纸谁都看不全，米拉指着他标得像豆芽的线笑，伊文也凑近，问能不能先从这两条究竟哪条走快说起，别一下把他们都煮进那盆温水。
